desc: M3W on URB. paper/BASELINES.md B12 (model-based MARL), which had no arm.
A SoftMoE dynamics model and a SparseMoE reward model over a learned
latent, with actions chosen by multi-agent MPPI over sampled joint route
assignments rather than by a policy.
Source: Zhao et al., NeurIPS 2025; code zhaozijie2022/m3w-marl.
Host block == iql/config1.json (the seed policy is URB's own DQN).
Every value below is the released configs/mujoco config.json verbatim:
latent_dim 128, simnorm_dim 8, num_dynamics_experts 16,
num_reward_experts 16, top_k 2, num_bins 101, reward_min/max -10/10,
balance_coef 0.0005, reward_coef 0.1, dynamics_coef 20, lr 0.0005,
and the plan block: num_samples 128, num_elites 16, iterations 6,
num_pi_trajs 8, temperature 0.5.
horizon = 1 (release: 3). A URB day is one step and the episode ends, so
a horizon above 1 plans over DAYS; the dynamics model is kept and
does exactly that when horizon is raised.
min_prob = 0.02   the categorical analogue of the release's min_std: a
floor on every route's probability after the MPPI refit.
graph = overlap, n_neighbors = 3   the coupling the reward model is
conditioned on, built by urb_baselines/graph.py exactly as DGN's is.
warmup_days = 100   planning under an untrained world model is noise;
the release calls this warmup_train.
normalize_reward = true   THE SILENT ONE. Two-hot over 101 bins spanning
[-10, 10] cannot represent URB's -1000: every reward lands in the
bottom bin, the reward model becomes a constant, every sampled joint
action scores identically and MPPI degenerates to a uniform draw --
while the loss curve looks healthy. false reproduces it; plan_spread
and clip in the diagnostics are how you see it.
